name: O'BRIEN, Edward (Ted) Lynam

headline.note: Official and first-person sources establish a wholly private pre-Parliament employment sequence through Defiance, the Australian Ricegrowers' Cooperative, Accenture, Barton Deakin and a sole-trader consultancy. They do not publish role-specific dates for the first four employers, hours, leave or overlap; more than ten years at Accenture is only an aggregate duration. The consultancy's registration is precisely bounded but its workload is not. Governance, party roles and elected office are excluded, so no full-time total is calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: O'Brien's biographies and first-speech material identify trainee baking in his family's Defiance business as his first job. Dates, age, hours, leave and employment entity are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: The role is private but has no countable full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: University of Queensland; London School of Economics; National Taiwan Normal University; University of Melbourne
career_spells.role: BA, Master of Economics, Asia Pacific Fellow in Mandarin and MBA student
career_spells.evidence_note: Official biographies list the degrees and fellowship but not complete attendance dates or overlap with employment.

career_spells.role: Operations and Business Development Manager, Asia Pacific; Country Manager, Taiwan
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography lists both roles and O'Brien's profiles describe progression to senior management in Asia. No dates, hours, leave, exact employing entity or role boundary are supplied.
career_spells.counting_note: Senior titles and ordering do not prove a full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official and member biographies identify Asian business-development work for the rice cooperative, including international negotiations and market-entry work, but publish no dates, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: No countable full-time interval is established.

career_spells.role: Strategy consulting and service delivery; Market Maker Lead, Greater China; Director of Growth and Strategy, Asia Pacific and Emerging Markets
career_spells.evidence_note: O'Brien says he spent more than ten years at Accenture, starting in Sydney strategy consulting and ending in Beijing as Director of Growth and Strategy; the official biography lists Market Maker Lead and Director roles. No start/end dates, role boundaries, hours, leave or secondments are published.
career_spells.counting_note: An aggregate duration and senior titles do not establish exact continuous full-time intervals.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography identifies O'Brien as Queensland Managing Director. Contemporary 2012 material identifies him in the role and reports that he established the Queensland operation; the office began in late 2011. He left before establishing his own active sole-trader entity in December 2013. Exact appointment/cessation, hours, leave and any campaign overlap are not established.
career_spells.counting_note: A year-level outer interval is supported, but exact continuous full-time service is not.

career_spells.employer: Ted O'Brien & Associates / Visible Hand Consulting (Edward Lynam O'Brien, sole trader)
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography identifies the managing-director role. Australian Business Register history shows the sole trader active and GST-registered from 1 December 2013 to 6 July 2016, Visible Hand Consulting registered from 5 December 2013, and Ted O'Brien & Associates from 11 January 2014. Client list, hours, leave, workload and the four-day overlap with parliamentary service are unpublished.
career_spells.counting_note: Business registration establishes an operating boundary, not full-time work throughout.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography gives a 2005–07 chair term. Paid status, hours and exact dates are not published.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official biography supplies the role and year-level interval; remuneration, hours and exact dates are not stated.
